papers.title: CoVeR: Coverage-Based Token Pruning for Multi-View 3D Reasoning in VLMs
papers.summary: Deterministic training-free multi-view token selector using spatial coverage; 8% of tokens preserve 93.5% performance on 3D reasoning benchmarks.

papers.title: 3DHarnessBench: Probing Agentic 3D-to-Code Capabilities of Frontier VLMs
papers.summary: Benchmark evaluating VLMs recovering 3D geometry as Blender Python code across four harness settings with active agentic exploration via Blender MCP.

papers.title: Unfold The World: Factorize 4D Properties in Reinforcing Spatial Reasoning (FactoSR)
papers.summary: Factorized RL framework decomposing world-consistent reasoning into XY correspondence, Z depth consistency, T temporal reversibility; +5.9% VSI-Bench.

papers.title: CAVE-NAV: VLM-Based Autonomous 3D Navigation in Underwater Cave Environments
papers.summary: VLM with CoT reasoning for underwater cave navigation using RGB, depth, sonar vertical-clearance; sim2real traversals without collisions.

papers.title: Beyond Single Object: Learning 3D Relations with Large Language Models (Multi-3DLLM)
papers.summary: Multi-object 3D comparison instruction dataset + Patch-Interaction Transformer; 3D-LLMs learn inter-object geometric reasoning.

papers.title: StateFlow: Building, Evolving, and Accessing 3D World States for Previsualization
papers.summary: State-centric generative previsualization: persistent structured 3D world state with construction/evolution/access stages; render-feedback reflection for camera plans.

papers.title: Distill What RGB Can Recover: Privileged 3D Evidence for RGB-Only VLMs
papers.summary: Privileged-evidence distillation converting training-time 3D evidence into RGB-only spatial reasoning; evidence-sensitivity-guided distillation down-weights non-recoverable targets.

papers.title: Lumera: Engine-Native Editable 3D World Reconstruction with Objects and Lighting
papers.summary: Light-aware 3D scene parsing from single image; Lumera-2K from 2513 UE5 projects; VLM parses object boxes and parametric light tuples.

papers.title: SoftNav: Injecting 3D Scene Tokens into VLMs for Embodied Navigation
papers.summary: Entity-level 3D continuous representations as soft tokens into VLM hidden space; 17M trainable params; SOTA on HM3D-OVON, zero-shot to GOAT-Bench and real robots.

papers.title: Ortho2CAD: 3D CAD generation from orthographic drawings using VLMs
papers.summary: VLM translates rasterized orthographic drawings to editable CadQuery code; geometry-grounded RL with solid IoU reward; GPT-5.5 self-refinement 100% valid code.

papers.title: IDEAL-Bench: Indoor Dataset and Evaluation suite for Analyzing 3D Layout reasoning
papers.summary: VLMs predict structured 3D layouts on photorealistic indoor scenes; strongest model only 62.1/100; sharp asymmetry between recognition and geometric regression.

papers.title: Disentangling Pictorial Cue Understanding from Language Bias in VLMs via Depth Ordering (O3-D)
papers.summary: Depth-ordering psychophysical tasks; 12 VLMs at 47-56% accuracy (chance); strong linguistic bias; CoT/ICL do not help depth understanding.

papers.title: MindEdit-Bench: Object-Level Counterfactual Spatial Reasoning in VLMs
papers.summary: Counterfactual spatial editing benchmark from smartphone triplets; VLM accuracy 8-31% vs human 81-97%; exposes fallback behavior.

papers.title: WorldRoamBench: Open-World Benchmark for Long-Horizon Stability of Interactive World Models
papers.summary: Four dimensions: action, vision drift, physics plausibility, memory (3D point-cloud reconstruction + VLM reasoning); 600+ cases; no model reliably satisfies all.

papers.title: PruneGround: Plug-and-play Spatial Pruning for 3D Visual Grounding
papers.summary: Language-Guided Spatial Pruning using frozen VLM to identify language-relevant regions; SOTA on ScanRefer and 9/10 Nr3D/Sr3D settings.

papers.title: RoboAtlas: Contextual Active SLAM
papers.summary: Active SLAM balancing geometric exploration and semantic reasoning via multi-armed bandit; 90.6% SR GOAT-Bench with GPT-4o, 88.8% with Qwen2.5-VL-7B.

papers.title: OneCanvas: 3D Scene Understanding via Panoramic Reprojection
papers.summary: Aggregate multi-view patch features onto equirectangular canvas with 3D position embeddings; SOTA on SQA3D/VSI-Bench with 10x less training compute.

papers.title: SpatialClaw: Rethinking Action Interface for Agentic Spatial Reasoning
papers.summary: Code-as-action-interface spatial agent with stateful Python kernel; 59.9% avg across 20 benchmarks, +11.2 over prior spatial agent.

papers.title: 3D Point Splatting for mmWave Radar Novel View Synthesis (3DPS)
papers.summary: Differentiable point renderer for radar with ITU-R material model and complex phasor splatting; 0.587 Pearson on ColoRadar, 1.7-5.2x baselines, 3min/scene.

papers.title: LangStreet: Persistent Language Fields for Anchor-Decoded Street Gaussians
papers.summary: Semantic ownership for language fields on view-conditioned 3DGS; 34.19 mIoU on KITTI with 2.72 GiB vs 12.90 GiB.

papers.title: Tri-DehazeGS: Scene-Medium Decoupled Gaussian Splatting with Transmittance-Aware Optimization
papers.summary: Scene-medium disentanglement: clean scene as Gaussians + view-shared tri-plane medium; MD-TGC gradient compensation after medium freezing.

papers.title: RIDE: Relocalization-Informed Depth Estimation with 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.summary: Dense metric depth from RGB stream combining PnP-RANSAC sparse metric depth with video-depth priors on 3DGS maps; temporal memory for gaps.

papers.title: View-Structured Conformal Prediction for 3D Gaussian Splatting (VSCP)
papers.summary: Conformal prediction over novel views: view-difficulty factor + View-CP quantile; 91.7-92% view coverage, 22.1% width cut, 216-280 FPS.

papers.title: LinearMask-GS: Stable-Mask Importance Pruning for Compact 3DGS
papers.summary: Linear increment activation replaces Gumbel-Sigmoid to keep mask values mid-confidence; 3.6x Gaussian reduction with quality gains.

papers.title: RouteBridge: Reliability-Routed Bidirectional Distillation Between NeRF and 3DGS
papers.summary: Per-ray reliability estimator routes supervision NeRF<->3DGS or abstains; +1.56dB over 3DGS on Mip-NeRF 360.

papers.title: CVT-GS: Learning to Simplify 3DGS with Centroidal Voronoi Tessellation
papers.summary: Optimization-free post-hoc 3DGS simplification via CVT cells; 100x point reduction, 12x faster than SOTA with +1.3dB PSNR.

papers.title: GSComplete: Gaussian Splat Completion with 2D Diffusion Priors
papers.summary: 3D generation via SDS with preservation loss completing only missing regions of Gaussian splats using 2D diffusion priors.

papers.title: EdMCGS: Event-Driven Markov Chain Gaussian Splatting for Extreme-Low-Frame-Rate Dynamic Scenes
papers.summary: Sparse RGB anchors states, events drive Markov transitions of 3D Gaussians; in-between motion generated from events, real-time rendering.

papers.title: FujinSplat: Seeing Through Smoke with RAW-Domain Gaussian Splatting
papers.summary: RAW-domain separation of medium and ISP; per-scene Base ISP frozen as photometric anchor; scene-agnostic controller regresses corrections.
